what: The labels a voice card may use. A value not on a list is recorded as unknown, never nudged onto the nearest one. Draft until the owner approves; delivery_style is NOT listed here — it is read from the doctrine's own delivery dial (components/marketing-doctrine/delivery.json), so the two never drift.

sources.read_style: voice-over casting's standard read styles (announcer / conversational / real person / peer-to-peer / character)
sources.texture: voice-quality vocabulary (GRBAS: roughness, breathiness, strain; Laver's voice-quality settings; casting descriptors)
